messages:
acme_sre: Hey team — during our enterprise eval the integration trips when we enable tool-calling. Sometimes the response is valid JSON, other times we get 'Unexpected token' in our parser and the webhook handler crashes. Also seeing 429s for identical requests.

sophie: thanks for flagging — can you paste the raw response body and any request headers (x-request-id, x-rate-limit-*)? I can loop in eng.

acme_sre: raw body: `{"error":"parse_error","message":"Unexpected token at position 67"}` Headers: `x-request-id: rdx-01f3`, `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 167`.

raj: that pattern smells like intermittent non-JSON output from the model. Are you using the structured-output/response format enforcement on the call or doing post-parse on our side? Also, what's your tool schema and the client flags (json_mode, function_call)?

acme_sre: we call with our tool schema (attached in DM) and set `tool_call: true` and `json_mode: strict`.

raj: ok — `json_mode: strict` will reject any tiny deviation. Two quick options: switch to `json_mode: best_effort` to be tolerant, or wrap the call in a stricter `response_format` that enforces a function signature. Also check for trailing commas/newlines in the prompt that can confuse the parser.

lucas: separate note — the 429s likely come from tenant rate-limiter. Their replay load was pretty spiky. Check `x-rate-limit-reset` and `Retry-After`. If you need immediate headroom we can request a temporary increase for the POC.

sophie: Acme, what's your QPS during the replay/test window?

acme_sre: bursts around 50 qps for ~2 mins, baseline ~12 qps.

lucas: hosted default burst ~20 qps for this tier — 50 will trigger 429. Two mitigations: client side backoff + reduce burst, or we provision dedicated capacity for the run. I can file the throughput request if sales approves.

olivia: security check — I noticed some requests include freeform metadata that may contain PII. Please confirm you scrub `email`/`ssn` fields before sending. We can also enable masking in logs for the POC.

acme_sre: we'll scrub sensitive fields at source, but we need to run end-to-end to validate the structured output path works with our real payloads.

raj: proposed action items:
1) switch `json_mode` to `best_effort` for now to avoid brittle parse failures
2) implement exponential backoff and honor `Retry-After` on 429
3) lower client replay burst to <=20 qps or ask for temporary throughput increase
4) send the full raw response + request id (rdx-01f3) so infra can pull the service logs

sophie: I'll coordinate a temporary Dedicated slot (2xA100) for the POC test window — faster repro and we can validate performance and stability. I'll update here once booked.

deploy-bot: [Automated] Alert: transient 429 spike observed on hosted-rt-us-west at 2026-03-21T15:04:22Z. Ticket created: INF-9243.

raj: thanks — once we have the rdx-01f3 logs and the DM with the minimal repro script I'll try to reproduce locally. If we can get the failing prompt and the exact tool schema I'll also run a stricter linter against the schema to catch nullable/extra-field mismatches.

acme_sre: sending a gist with a small repro script and the failing response in DM to @raj. Appreciate the help — we'll apply best_effort and backoff and retest.

sophie: noted. I'll chase throughput approval and confirm Dedicated slot by EOD. :+1:
